title: hieracium djimilense subsp. terekianum
intro: Hieracium djimilense subsp. terekianum, commonly known as Mountain Hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Hawkweed include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential remedy for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
